key_idea: All strips are the same length, so the pair that overlaps the most is the shortest.
steps: All the strips are the same length.
Where 2 strips are bolted, they lie on top of each other. More bolts means more overlap.
Count the bolts: A has 2, B has 3, C has 5, D has 4 and E has 1.
C overlaps the most, so C is the shortest.

choice_feedback.A: A has only 2 bolts. C has 5, so C overlaps more.
choice_feedback.B: B has 3 bolts. C has 5, so C overlaps more.
choice_feedback.D: D has 4 bolts. C has 5, so C overlaps more.
choice_feedback.E: E has only 1 bolt. It overlaps the least, so it is the longest.
